# WeddingMath

> Local wedding math from published studies. The Knot and Zola stay side by side. Training use is declined in robots.txt (Content-Signal: ai-train=no). Search and citation of these pages is fine.

National Knot average $34,200. National Zola average $36,000. Knot median $24,000. Knot per guest $292. Honeymoon $5,500 (Knot) and $5,300 (Zola).

## Tools
- [Wedding cost calculator](https://weddingmath.co/): ZIP or city, guests, optional budget
- [Wedding budget tools](https://weddingmath.co/tools)
- [Wedding budget calculator](https://weddingmath.co/budget): category split
- [How much can we afford for a wedding](https://weddingmath.co/budget/reverse)
- [Wedding cost per guest calculator](https://weddingmath.co/budget/per-guest)
- [Wedding budget tracker](https://weddingmath.co/budget/tracker)
- [Honeymoon budget](https://weddingmath.co/honeymoon): hands off to VacationMath
- [How much does a wedding cost](https://weddingmath.co/wedding-cost): state index
- [Wedding planning guides](https://weddingmath.co/guides)
- [Guest list](https://weddingmath.co/guests)
- [Shopping lists](https://weddingmath.co/shop)
- [Wedding cost sources](https://weddingmath.co/sources): every figure, source, and date

## Rules
City figures are tier A. State figures are tier B. Metros without a wedding survey are tier C estimates: state wedding data times the metro BEA price level divided by the state price level, labeled estimated. Guest-count bands are a reference, not the calculator's step multiplier.
